inputs.source_filter: day_of_week not in('Saturday','Sunday') AND route_type in('Local','Limited','SBS')

baseline.note: The plan does not define a baseline period. We chose the 12 months before the plan (July 2025 to June 2026). Speeds are average weekday bus speed.

corridors.name: E Gun Hill Rd
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment whose two timepoint stops are both on East Gun Hill Rd in the Bronx; in the catalog that is only the stretch between White Plains Rd and Boston Rd/Hering Av (Bx28, Bx38).
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. Catalog spells it EAST GUN HILL RD; no WEST GUN HILL RD stops exist. Coverage is thin: BX28 and BX38 share the same stop pairs, so the 4 rows are 2 physical segments (do not sum miles across routes). Excluded because one stop is off the road, although the bus runs mostly on it: BAINBRIDGE AV/E 206 ST <-> EAST GUN HILL RD/WHITE PLAINS RD (1.1-1.2 mi) and EAST GUN HILL RD/HERING AV or /BOSTON RD <-> BARTOW AV (1.1-1.2 mi). School-only rows (BX28 from Bronxwood Av, BX30) excluded.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx28 and Bx38 between White Plains Rd and Boston Rd/Hering Av, about 0.7 miles of a road roughly 3 miles long. The rest of East Gun Hill Rd has no bus timepoint pair on the road.

corridors.name: E Kingsbridge Rd
corridors.definition: Bx9 Local segments between the Kingsbridge Rd timepoint at Jerome Av/Morris Av and the EAST FORDHAM RD/3 AV timepoint; they run the full length of East Kingsbridge Rd (Jerome Av to E Fordham Rd) plus a short piece of E Fordham Rd.
corridors.notes: Stated assumption, an exception to the both-stops-on-street rule: the catalog has a single timepoint location on Kingsbridge Rd east of Jerome Av (EAST KINGSBRIDGE RD/MORRIS AV northbound, WEST KINGSBRIDGE RD/JEROME AV southbound, about 70 m apart at the East/West boundary), so no segment has both stops on the road and the strict rule yields 0 segments. East Kingsbridge Rd ends at E Fordham Rd just west of the EAST FORDHAM RD/3 AV timepoint, so these two Bx9 segments cover the whole road; the off-road share (roughly 15-20%, on E Fordham Rd at Fordham Plaza) is an estimate from stop coordinates, not a measurement. One WebSearch used: MTA lists the Bx9 as running via Broadway / Kingsbridge Rd / Southern Blvd, with E Kingsbridge Rd stops at Grand Concourse, E 192 St and E Fordham Rd. Excluded: BX22 (northbound uses the same stop pair but also has a timepoint at E Fordham Rd/Valentine Av and southbound runs via Valentine Av, so its alignment on Kingsbridge Rd is not confirmed), BX28/BX38 (other end at Valentine Av/E 192 St or Bainbridge Av/E 206 St), every West Kingsbridge Rd segment west of Jerome Av, and School rows. A reader who rejects one-end segments should treat this corridor as unmapped.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx9 between Jerome Av and E Fordham Rd, which follows East Kingsbridge Rd plus a short piece of E Fordham Rd. The stop data has only one timepoint on the road, so this is an approximation.

corridors.name: E Fordham Rd
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment with both stops on Fordham Rd (East or West) between Sedgwick Av and Boston Rd, the limits the plan gives for its Fordham Road project on this corridor.
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. Stated assumption: the corridor list says 'E Fordham Rd', but the plan's item 3 is 'Fordham Road, Sedgwick Avenue to Boston Road', so West Fordham Rd (Sedgwick Av to Jerome Av, spelled WEST FORDHAM RD and W FORDHAM RD) is included. A strict reader can keep only the segments with both stops on EAST FORDHAM RD: BX12 E 100798->100799, BX12 E 100799->104015, BX12 E 104240->104015, BX12 W 103999->104235, BX22 N 104090->902239. Rows include overlapping alternates (two University Av stop ids, skip-stop timepoint patterns), so summing miles double counts; the unique path is about 1.0 mi eastbound and 0.94 mi westbound. East of 3 Av the plan's project continues on E Fordham Rd and Pelham Pkwy to Boston Rd, but every segment there (BX12 to/from PELHAM PKWY/WHITE PLAINS RD, BX22 to Boston Rd/Bronx Park East, BX9 to Southern Blvd) has one stop off Fordham Rd and is excluded. BX12+ SBS has no Fordham Rd timepoints at all (its segments run 5.5-6.2 mi from Broadway to Westchester Av), so the SBS itself is not measured. FORDHAM PLAZA/BUS TERMINAL (BX17) is off-street. No WebSearch used.
corridors.public_note: The plan covers Fordham Road from Sedgwick Av to Boston Rd. We measured Bx12 and Bx22 segments from Sedgwick Av to 3 Av/Webster Av, about 1 mile per direction. East of 3 Av there are no usable stop pairs. Segments that lack data in some baseline months are listed on the corridor page but not used.

corridors.name: White Plains Rd
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment with both stops on White Plains Rd inside the Bronx (lat <= 40.905, excludes Mount Vernon).
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. White Plains Rd appears only in the Bronx in the catalog; the lat <= 40.905 clip is a safeguard. Only BX39 has both stops on the road. Excluded as one-ended: BX39 to/from E 241 ST/CRANFORD AV and SOUNDVIEW AV, and BX41, BX41+ SBS, BX36, BX22, BX30, BX5, BX8, which each touch White Plains Rd at a single timepoint.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx39 between Westchester Av and E 233 St, about 4.3 miles per direction. Other parts of White Plains Rd have no usable stop pair.

corridors.name: E Tremont Ave
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment with both stops on East Tremont Ave in the Bronx (catalog spelling variants merged); in the catalog these all lie between Castle Hill Av and Randall Av/Roosevelt Av (Bx40, Bx42).
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. Merged typo spellings EASTTREMONT AV and EAST TREMONT A. Bare 'TREMONT AV' and 'WEST TREMONT AV' stops excluded. Stated assumption: the corridor is all of East Tremont Ave, not just the plan's item 5 (Tremont Avenue Busway, Webster Av to Southern Blvd, Bx36). Consequence a skeptic must know: none of the mapped segments is on the busway; they start more than 1.5 miles east of its Southern Blvd end, so this corridor's speeds will not show the busway's effect. The only catalog segments that cross the busway are BX36 E 100149->903254 (UNIVERSITY AV/W 174 ST -> EAST TREMONT AV/E 177 ST, 2.638 mi) and BX36 W 903255->802186 (EAST TREMONT AV/BOSTON RD -> UNIVERSITY AV/ W 175 ST, 2.476 mi), Local and Limited; they are excluded because one stop is on University Av and the busway (roughly 0.7 mi, estimate) is under a third of their length. One WebSearch used: an MTA notice says the Bx36 runs on E Tremont Av between Webster Av and White Plains Rd. Bx40/Bx42 use E 180 St, not Tremont, between Webster Av and Boston Rd. Also excluded: BX42 E 103683->102613 ends at RANDALL AV/EAST TREMONT AV (stop is on Randall Av; BX40 E covers the same stretch); BX21, BX9, BX8, BX4, BX31 touch Tremont at a single timepoint. BX40 and BX42 share stop pairs, so do not sum miles across routes.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx40 and Bx42 from Castle Hill Av to Randall Av/Roosevelt Av, about 2.2 miles. The plan's Tremont Avenue Busway stretch (Webster Av to Southern Blvd) has no usable segment, so it is not covered.

corridors.name: Grand Concourse
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment with both stops on the Grand Concourse (Bronx only street of that name in the catalog).
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. BX1 Limited counted. BX1 and BX2 share one stop pair in each direction, so summing miles across routes double counts. North of E Fordham Rd and south of E 149 St the segments end off the Concourse (Mosholu Pkwy, Sedgwick Av, Lincoln Av, 3 Av, E 149 St/Courtlandt Av) and are excluded.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx1 and Bx2 from E 149 St to E Fordham Rd, about 3.5 miles per direction. The two routes share part of the road, so their segments overlap.

corridors.name: 3rd Ave
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment with both stops on 3 Av in the Bronx (lon > -73.93 and lat > 40.81, which excludes the 3 Av stops in Manhattan and Brooklyn).
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. Manhattan and Brooklyn 3 AV excluded by coordinates, not by the borough column. BX15 Limited counted. The 16 rows include overlapping alternates (Local timepoint at E 168 St vs Limited at E 169 St, two stop ids at E Tremont Av southbound), so summing miles double counts; the unique path is about 3.5 mi each way. South of E 149 St (to E 138 St) only one-ended segments exist. BX41 and BX41+ SBS start on 3 Av at 148/149 St but end on Melrose Av/Webster Av; BX1, BX2 and M125 touch 3 Av at one timepoint only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx15 and Bx21 along 3rd Av from Westchester Av to E Fordham Rd/E 189 St, about 3.5 miles per direction. Some segments overlap. Two are left out because the source changed their recorded length during the comparison period.

corridors.name: Southern Blvd
corridors.definition: Every Local/Limited/SBS segment with both stops on Southern Blvd (Bronx only street of that name in the catalog).
corridors.notes: Segments are timepoint-to-timepoint; only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept (Express, School, School Limited excluded). Duplicate rows across route types removed. South of E 163 St/Hunts Point Av there is no timepoint pair on the boulevard. BX9 runs on Southern Blvd between E Fordham Rd and E Tremont Av but its segments end at EAST TREMONT AV/E 177 ST, BOSTON RD/E 178 ST or EAST FORDHAM RD/3 AV and are excluded; BX19 and BX5 segments toward E 149 St and Story Av are one-ended.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx19 along Southern Blvd from Hunts Point Av/E 163 St to the Botanical Garden stop, about 2.9 miles per direction, plus a short Bx5 piece inside that stretch. Southern Blvd south of E 163 St has no usable stop pair.

corridors.name: Tremont/Cross Bronx
corridors.definition: Plan gives no street extents: it is a future rapid-bus visioning study after the Tremont Ave busway and the Reimagine the Cross Bronx study.
corridors.notes: Plan text: after the Tremont Avenue Busway, NYC DOT/MTA will launch visioning for new rapid bus options for cross-borough travel. No streets, endpoints or routes named. Cross Bronx Expwy has no local timepoints (only BXM express stops, excluded). Tremont Ave itself is already corridor 5. Not guessed.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan names this corridor only as a future rapid bus study and gives no streets or routes, so there is nothing to measure yet.

corridors.name: South Bronx Crosstown
corridors.definition: Bx6 and Bx13 Local segments with both stops on E 161 St or E 163 St between River Av and Southern Blvd, the Bronx street alignment of the Bx6 SBS.
corridors.notes: Plan: capital project improving 1.75 miles of streets along the Bx6 SBS route, no endpoints given. Stated assumption: that stretch is E 161 St/E 163 St between River Av and Southern Blvd. Two WebSearches used: press coverage of the 2026 capital project describes E 161 St from Ruppert Pl to Morris Av plus E 163 St between Washington Av and Tiffany St; sources disagree and none gives official limits, but all named limits fall inside River Av-Southern Blvd, so the extent stays an assumption. Reviewer added BX13 (E 161 ST/RIVER AV <-> E 163 ST/3 AV, about 0.98 mi each way): both stops are on corridor streets inside the extent. It overlaps the Bx6 River Av-Melrose Av segment, so do not sum miles across routes. BX6+ SBS is excluded because its timepoint segments run from Riverside Dr in Manhattan to E 163 St/Southern Blvd (3.6-3.7 mi, including W 155 St and the Macombs Dam Bridge), so the SBS itself is not measured, only the locals on the same streets. Bx6 alternates ending at HUNTS POINT AV stops, the Hunts Point Av/Food Center Dr tail and the Manhattan end are excluded. Only Local/Limited/SBS route types kept.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Bx6 and Bx13 along E 161 St and E 163 St from River Av to Southern Blvd, about 1.95 miles per direction. The plan says 1.75 miles and gives no endpoints, so this stretch is our best reading.

corridors.name: Upper Manhattan North-South
corridors.notes: The plan names this corridor only in the Priority Corridors table and on the map; it gives no streets, endpoints, routes or project description. Review re-checked the plan text for Upper Manhattan, Harlem, Washington Heights, Inwood and M-route mentions and found none. Not mapped, because any street choice would be a guess. No web search used.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan names this corridor but gives no streets, routes or project description, so we did not guess.

corridors.name: 125th St
corridors.definition: 125th St in Manhattan between Amsterdam Av and 3 Av in both directions, plus Amsterdam Av to St Clair Pl westbound (M125 timepoints).
corridors.notes: Only M125 has consecutive timepoints that are both named on 125th St (eastbound 1.24 mi, westbound 1.56 mi), so the corridor speed is M125 only. Segments that run along 125th St but have one stop named on a cross street are excluded by the both-stops rule: M101 N E 125 ST/3 AV to AMSTERDAM AV/W 125 ST (1.28 mi), M101 S W 125 ST/AMSTERDAM AV to LEXINGTON AV/E 124 ST (1.16 mi), M125 E SAINT CLAIRE PL/W 125 ST to W 125 ST/AMSTERDAM AV (0.38 mi), M60 SBS BROADWAY/W 106 ST to E 125 ST/LEXINGTON AV (2.36 mi), and the M100 and M125 segments that leave 125th St. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M125 along 125th St between Amsterdam Av and 3 Av. The plan gives no limits. No usable segment covers 125th St east of 3 Av.

corridors.name: Lexington Ave (95th to 125th St)
corridors.definition: Lexington Av from 95th St to 125th St, southbound (the avenue is one-way southbound).
corridors.notes: M101 and M103 cover E 124 St to E 96 St; M102 joins at E 100 St (its segment from Malcolm X Blvd ends on Lexington but starts off it). The E 96 St to E 68 St segment is excluded (4% inside the limits). Summed miles (3.12) count the same 1.45 mi stretch once per route. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M101, M102 and M103 southbound on Lexington Av from E 124 St to E 96 St, which covers the plan's 95th to 125th St. The three routes run over the same blocks, so their segments overlap.

corridors.name: 116th St
corridors.definition: 116th St in Manhattan plus Pleasant Av, Manhattan Av and Morningside Av, the four streets the plan names for this project; in the catalog this is M116 on 116th St (Frederick Douglass Blvd to Pleasant Av) and on Pleasant Av (E 120 St to E 116 St).
corridors.notes: Plan: improvements along 116th Street, Manhattan Avenue, Morningside Avenue and Pleasant Avenue for 10 routes and 65,000 riders. Only M116 has timepoint pairs on these streets: eastbound Frederick Douglass Blvd to Madison Av (0.65 mi), westbound Pleasant Av/E 120 St to Frederick Douglass Blvd (1.53 mi). No segment has both stops on Manhattan Av or Morningside Av in Manhattan. Excluded by the both-stops rule although they use these streets: M116 E E 116 ST/MADISON AV to 1 AV/E 116 ST (0.56 mi), M116 W E 120 ST/PLEASANT AV to E 116 ST/PLEASANT AV, the M116 and M7 segments between W 116 ST/FREDERICK DOUGLASS BLVD and W 106 St, and M3 N MANHATTAN AV/W 111 ST to SAINT NICHOLAS AV/W 125 ST. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M116 only, on 116th St. The plan also names Pleasant Av, Manhattan Av and Morningside Av but gives no limits, and few usable stop pairs lie on them. Treat this as part of the corridor.

corridors.name: 79th St
corridors.definition: 79th St from Riverside Dr to East End Av (M79 SBS), both directions.
corridors.notes: Eastbound covers Riverside Dr to 5 Av (1.31 mi); westbound covers East End Av to Broadway (2.07 mi). Excluded: M79 SBS westbound W 79 ST/BROADWAY to W 79 ST/RIVERSIDE DR, whose catalog length is 0.94 mi for a 0.13 mi block (eastbound is 0.12 mi), so it is a terminal turnaround loop mostly off 79th St. Also excluded: eastbound E 79 ST/5 AV to E 80 ST/EAST END AV (0.96 mi), because the terminal stop is named on E 80 St. The Broadway to 5 Av segment includes the Central Park transverse; the plan cites 1.65 miles of streets for a stretch that is about 2.0 mi end to end. M79+ rows appear under both Limited and SBS route types and are counted once. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M79 SBS between Riverside Dr and East End Av, both directions. One westbound segment near Riverside Dr is left out because it is mostly a terminal loop off 79th St.

corridors.name: Midtown Crosstown
corridors.notes: The plan names this corridor only in the Priority Corridors table and on the map; it gives no streets, endpoints or routes. It may overlap the 34th, 42nd, 49th/50th or 57th St crosstowns, but the plan does not say, so it is not mapped. No web search used.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan names this corridor but gives no streets or routes, so we did not guess.

corridors.name: 34th St Busway
corridors.definition: 34th St from 3 Av to 9 Av (M34 SBS and M34A SBS), both directions, using every 34th St timepoint segment with at least 30% of its length inside those limits.
corridors.notes: Assumption: straddling segments are kept. 34th St timepoints are only at 12 Av, 7 Av and 2 Av/1 Av, so no segment sits wholly inside the busway (about 1.0 mi). The 7 Av to 2 Av/1 Av segments are 73-83% inside. The 12 Av to 7 Av segments are only 38-40% inside (the 9 Av to 7 Av part) and are kept because nothing else covers 7 Av to 9 Av; westbound they are 0.97-0.98 mi against 0.77 mi eastbound, so they include a turnaround west of 12 Av. Two stop-ID variants of the 12 Av/7 Av stretch and the shared M34/M34A segments mean summed miles (9.12) count the same street several times. Segments to Marginal St, the ferry terminal, Waterside, W 43 St or 9 AV/W 42 ST have a stop off 34th St and are excluded. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M34 SBS and M34A SBS between 3 Av and 9 Av. No segment sits entirely inside the busway (about 1 mile), so we kept segments that are at least 30% inside. Speeds include some blocks outside the busway.

corridors.name: 9th Avenue
corridors.definition: 9th Av from 32nd St to 50th St (M11 southbound; the avenue is one-way southbound), using the one 9th Av timepoint segment, W 42 St to W 23 St.
corridors.notes: Assumption: the straddling segment is kept. M11 S 9 AV/W 42 ST to 9 AV/W 23 ST is 53% inside (42nd to 32nd St); the 32nd to 23rd St part is outside. 42nd to 50th St is not covered: the only segment there is M11 S COLUMBUS AV/W 66 ST to 9 AV/W 42 ST (1.2 mi), whose first stop is named on Columbus Av (9th Av north of 59th St) and which is only about a third inside. 49 AV and other Queens/Brooklyn names are excluded by exact name and location. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on one M11 southbound segment from W 42 St to W 23 St, about half of which lies inside the plan's 32nd to 50th St limits. With one segment, treat it as rough.

corridors.name: Lexington Ave (52nd to 60th St)
corridors.definition: Lexington Av from 60th St to 52nd St, southbound (the avenue is one-way southbound), using the one timepoint segment that crosses it, E 59 St to E 42 St.
corridors.notes: Assumption: the straddling segment is kept. LEXINGTON AV/E 59 ST to LEXINGTON AV/E 42 ST (M101, M102, M103; 0.89 mi) is 38% inside (59th to 52nd St) and 62% south of the project, so this corridor is a weak proxy. The E 68 St to E 59 St segment is 11% inside and excluded. The plan cites eight routes; the others are Express (excluded) or have no consecutive Lexington timepoints here (M98 runs W 178 St to E 68 St as one segment). Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M101, M102 and M103 southbound, E 59 St to E 42 St. Under half of that segment lies inside the plan's 52nd to 60th St limits, so this is a weak stand-in.

corridors.name: 6th Ave
corridors.definition: 6th Av (Avenue of the Americas) from Lispenard St to 59th St, northbound (the avenue is one-way northbound).
corridors.notes: Both spellings are matched; AVENUE OF THE AMERICAS adds no segment, because among kept route types it appears only on M7 S 7 AV/W 34 ST to AVENUE OF THE AMERICAS/W 16 ST, which runs on 7th Av. M55 and M5 chain Grand St to W 57 St (3.23 mi); M7 W 15/16 St to W 34 St overlaps that chain, so summed miles (5.06) exceed the street length. Excluded for a stop named on a cross street: M55 N 6 AV/W 31 ST to W 44 ST/6 AV. M5 N W 31 ST/6 AV to 6 AV/W 42 ST is not excluded: its stop is about 0.03 mi from the mapped 6 AV/W 31 ST stop on the same block and similar length, so the stop-location merge counts it as the same segment (stop ids 405505 and 803083). The plan cites 31 routes; most are Express (excluded). Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M5, M55 and M7 northbound along 6th Av from Grand St to W 57 St, which covers the plan's Lispenard St to 59th St. The routes overlap on some blocks. Two stop ids for the 6 AV/W 31 ST stop (one named W 31 ST/6 AV) are counted as the same stop.

corridors.name: Madison Ave
corridors.definition: Madison Av from 23rd St to 42nd St, northbound (the avenue is one-way northbound), using the timepoint segments that start at E 28 St or E 32 St and end at E 57/58 St.
corridors.notes: Assumption: straddling segments are kept. M1, M2 and M3 E 28 St to E 57/58 St (1.46 mi) are 46% inside; M4 E 32 St to E 57 St (1.26 mi) is 37% inside. More than half of each segment is north of 42nd St, so the speed reflects Midtown above the project as well. 23rd to 28th St is not covered: M1/M2/M3 N 4 AV/E 10 ST to MADISON AV/E 28 ST starts off Madison. The plan cites 34 routes; most are Express (excluded). MADISON ST is a different street and is not matched. Rule applied: both stops on a listed street, both in Manhattan by lat/lon, Local/Limited/SBS only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the M1, M2, M3 and M4 northbound on Madison Av. The segments reach well north of the plan's 23rd to 42nd St limits, so speeds include Midtown blocks outside the project.

corridors.name: Broadway
corridors.definition: Broadway from 14th St to Houston St (per plan); no catalog segment qualifies.
corridors.notes: The plan defines the street and limits, but no catalog segment of any route type has both stops on Broadway inside them. Closest: M55 S 5 AV/W 23 ST to BROADWAY/WEST HOUSTON ST (1.39 mi, first stop on 5th Av, most of the path off Broadway); Express SIM7/SIM9/SIM33 from BROADWAY/E 13 ST to West St and X27/X28 from E 23 ST/BROADWAY to BROADWAY/BROOME ST (Express, and one stop off or outside). M1/M2/M3 southbound end at E 8 ST/LAFAYETTE ST or 4 AV/E 9 ST. Adding the M55 segment would break the both-stops rule, so the corridor stays unmapped until the feed has a Broadway timepoint pair here. No web search used.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan limits are Broadway from 14th St to Houston St, but no bus segment has both stops on that stretch of Broadway.

corridors.name: Northern Blvd
corridors.definition: Segments whose both timepoint stops are on Northern Blvd in Queens (catalog spellings NORTHERN BLVD and NORTHERN BL).
corridors.notes: The plan names Northern Blvd only as a rapid bus study, with no limits. Only Q12, Q63 and Q66 have consecutive timepoints both on Northern Blvd; routes that turn on or off it (Q13, Q28, Q101, and the Q12/Q63/Q66 hops into downtown Flushing) have one stop on another street and are left out, so roughly half of the street, including the Flushing and Corona section, is not measured. Review added Q12 W NORTHERN BL/WESTMORELAND ST to NORTHERN BLVD/232 ST, missed because of its spelling: since June 2025 it replaces the Morgan St to Bell Blvd segment, whose rows stop in 2025-06. Timepoints changed in June 2025, so several listed segments are before/after versions of the same stretch (Q66 Woodside Av/Newtown Rd vs 54 St/Broadway). Q66 School-only segments (78 St to 82 St to Junction Blvd) and QM3 Express are excluded.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q12, Q63 and Q66 where both stops are on Northern Blvd. The plan gives no limits. Two stretches are covered: Woodside Av to Junction Blvd, and the far east end. Nothing qualifies between Junction Blvd and 163 St.

corridors.name: Jackson Heights Hub
corridors.definition: Plan item 24 is "Broadway, Brooklyn Queens Expressway to Roosevelt Avenue, Queens" (Q70 SBS to LaGuardia), but no MTA segment has both timepoints on Broadway in that stretch.
corridors.notes: Plan item 24 names Broadway from the BQE to Roosevelt Av, 9,000 daily riders on the Q70. Item numbers in the plan detail section match the corridor list for the other Queens items (25, 30 to 34), and Broadway/Roosevelt Av/74 St is the Jackson Heights station complex, so reading item 24 as the Jackson Heights Hub is well supported (only detail items 26 and 27 are numbered differently from the list). The stretch is short (well under a mile). The only segment that contains it is Q70+ 74 ST/ROOSEVELT AV STATION to LAGUARDIA AIRPORT/TERMINAL C (3.99 mi, mostly expressway), which would measure highway speed, not Broadway. The other Q70+ segments run Roosevelt Av/61 St to the 74 St station and LaGuardia to Woodside Av/61 St. Q47 has single stops at BROADWAY/ROOSEVELT AV and 75 ST/BROADWAY but no pair on Broadway. Left unmapped because no segment can stand in for it without guessing.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan limits are Broadway from the BQE to Roosevelt Av (Q70 SBS), but no bus segment has both stops on that stretch.

corridors.name: Grand Ave/Grand St
corridors.definition: Segments with both stops on Grand St or Grand Av from the Grand St/Metropolitan Av junction (Newtown Creek) east to Queens Blvd.
corridors.notes: Plan: "Metropolitan Avenue to Queens Boulevard", Q59, Q58, Q98. The Grand St/Metropolitan Av junction is the GRAND ST/METRO BRIDGE stop (lon -73.932), confirmed by the mapper with 1 WebSearch; both stops must be east of lon -73.9355. Q98 has no segment with both stops on Grand. Q58 joins Grand Av at 71/72 St, so it only adds the eastern mile. Excluded for crossing the west limit: Q59 W GRAND ST/GRAND ST BRIDGE to GRAND ST/GRAHAM AV (1.09 mi, about 60% west of Metropolitan Av), so westbound coverage stops at the Grand St Bridge, about 0.4 mi short of Metropolitan Av; eastbound starts at Metropolitan Av. Q54 and Q59 Grand St segments west of the junction (Graham Av, Lorimer St, Morgan Av) are outside the limits. School-only Q58 segments (74 St) are excluded. Q59 E Page Pl to 64 St to 73 St (rows through 2025-06) and Page Pl to 73 St (rows from 2025-06) are the same stretch before and after a timepoint change.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q58 and Q59 along Grand St and Grand Av toward Queens Blvd. Eastbound starts at Metropolitan Av; westbound ends about 0.4 miles short of it. One Q59 segment is left out because the source changed its recorded length.

corridors.name: 108th St
corridors.definition: Segments with both stops on 108 St in Queens between Queens Blvd and Roosevelt Av, plus the same southbound run when its last stop is recorded around the corner at 70 Rd/Queens Blvd.
corridors.notes: Plan (detail item numbered 27): "108th Street, Queens Boulevard to Astoria Boulevard", three routes, 35,000 riders. Only Q23 has pairs on 108 St; Q58 (108 St/Horace Harding Expwy) and Q48 (Roosevelt Av/108 St) have single stops there but no pair on 108 St. The stretch from Roosevelt Av to Astoria Blvd is inside Q23 108 ST/ROOSEVELT AV to DITMARS BLVD/102 ST (1.4 mi, about 40% on other streets) and is left out. Review added Q23 S 108 ST/HORACE HARDING EXPWY to 70 RD/QUEENS BLVD (stop ids 701030 and 982461). This is a stated exception to the both-stops rule: the stop is on 70 Rd, 0.06 mi from 108 ST/QUEENS BLVD, and the 1.12-mi run is the same. Without it the southbound Horace Harding to Queens Blvd half has rows only for 2025-07 to 2026-06 (the baseline) and vanishes from 2026-07, when the feed switched to the 70 Rd stop, which would change the segment mix exactly at the plan date. No segment qualifies before June 2025 (the old Q23 timepoints were 71 Av/Queens Blvd and 108 St/62 Dr).
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q23 along 108 St from Queens Blvd to Roosevelt Av, about 2.1 miles. The plan runs on to Astoria Blvd, about 0.8 miles more, which no segment covers. The source switched one southbound stop in July 2026, so that segment has no data since release; the corridor page says how many segments still report.

corridors.name: Main St/Linden Pl
corridors.definition: Segments with both stops on Main St in Queens, over the full length the catalog covers (Union Tpke to 38/39 Av in Flushing).
corridors.notes: The plan gives no limits for Main St/Linden Pl (2 WebSearches in total, mapper and reviewer, found none). Review change: the first pass cut Main St at Horace Harding Expwy on the assumption that the corridor is the Flushing core. The plan does not say that, and the other no-limit streets in this tracker are mapped at the full length the catalog covers, so the six Q20/Q20A/Q20B segments between Union Tpke and 60 Av/Horace Harding Expwy (1.81 mi each) were added. To restore the narrower reading, drop the segments that touch MAIN ST/UNION TPKE. Linden Pl has no Local, Limited or SBS segment (only QM express stops at Whitestone Expwy/Linden Pl), so the northern half of the corridor name is not measured. Q44 SBS runs on Main St but its timepoints are Merrick Blvd/Archer Av, Main St/39 Av and Parsons Blvd/14 Av, so it has no pair on Main St (its only Main St pairs are School Limited trips, excluded). Q20A and Q20B rows end in 2025-06; Q20 rows start in 2025-06. The Q27 loop MAIN ST/39 AV to MAIN ST/39 AV (0.07 mi) is dropped as a terminal loop.
corridors.public_note: The plan gives no limits, so we used all of Main St in Queens that the data covers, Union Tpke to 38/39 Av, on the Q20, Q20A and Q20B. Nothing covers Linden Pl or Main St south of Union Tpke.

corridors.name: Kissena Blvd/Union St/Parsons Blvd
corridors.definition: Segments whose both stops are on Kissena Blvd, Union St or Parsons Blvd in Queens.
corridors.notes: Plan gives only the three street names, no extent. 1 WebSearch confirmed these are the Q25/Q34 alignment (Kissena to Parsons, Flushing-Jamaica). Because timepoints are sparse many Q25/Q34 hops are cross-street to cross-street across turns (e.g. Kissena->Main St) and are not captured; coverage is partial.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q20B, Q25 and Q34 where both stops are on Kissena Blvd, Union St or Parsons Blvd. Many hops across turns are not captured, so coverage is partial.

corridors.name: Ridgewood Busway
corridors.definition: Planned new busway on the unused right-of-way under the Myrtle Av elevated M line; no existing bus service or segments.
corridors.notes: Plan (item 26 in detail section): preliminary engineering starts 2026; routes affected not named ("many local buses"). Could be approximated by Myrtle Av segments (B54, Q55) but plan does not name them: not mapped to avoid guessing.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. This is a planned new busway with no existing bus service on the route, so there is nothing to measure yet.

corridors.name: Woodhaven/Metropolitan
corridors.definition: Woodhaven Blvd segments that end at the Metropolitan Av intersection (Q11, Q21 between Jamaica Av and Metropolitan Av), used as a coarse stand-in for the short project there.
corridors.notes: Plan: "Woodhaven Boulevard, 73rd Avenue to Yellowstone Boulevard", a 0.25-mile segment on both ends of the Woodhaven Blvd/Metropolitan Av intersection, 34,000 daily riders. No catalog segment is that short. The only pairs on Woodhaven Blvd that touch the intersection run 1.4 mi south to Jamaica Av, so at most about 0.25 mi of each lies inside the project and the rest is outside it (it is inside corridor 31). The north arm exists only as WOODHAVEN BLVD/METROPOLITAN AV to QUEENS BLVD/59 AV and HOFFMAN DR/WOODHAVEN BLVD to WOODHAVEN BLVD/METROPOLITAN AV (1.7 mi, one stop named for another street) and is left out. Q52+/Q53+ SBS pairs (Jamaica Av to Queens Blvd/Hoffman Dr, 3.1 mi) are left out for the same reason. Q21 rows end in 2025-08. These four segments are also in corridor 31: do not add the two corridors together, and read this one as "Woodhaven Blvd south of Metropolitan Av", not as a measurement of the project block.
corridors.public_note: Measured on Q11 and Q21 segments on Woodhaven Blvd from Jamaica Av to Metropolitan Av, a stand-in for the plan's short project around Metropolitan Av. These segments are much longer than the project. Woodhaven (Union Turnpike/107 Ave) uses some of the same segments.

corridors.name: Woodhaven (Union Turnpike/107 Ave)
corridors.definition: Segments with both stops on Woodhaven Blvd or on its continuation Cross Bay Blvd, between Metropolitan Av (nearest timepoint north of Union Tpke) and 107 Av.
corridors.notes: Plan: "Woodhaven Boulevard, Union Turnpike to 107th Avenue", two miles along the Q52 SBS and Q53 SBS, 34,000 riders. Review found the first pass covered only the northern half: the catalog puts CROSS BAY BLVD/107 AV at lat 40.6788, about 1.0 mi south of Jamaica Av (lat 40.6937), not next to it. Woodhaven Blvd continues as Cross Bay Blvd from Rockaway Blvd/Liberty Av south, and 107 Av is just south of Liberty Av, so the six Q11/Q21 segments between WOODHAVEN BLVD/JAMAICA AV and CROSS BAY BLVD at Rockaway Blvd, Liberty Av or 107 Av were added and CROSS BAY BLVD was added to the streets (only north of 107 Av; the rest of Cross Bay Blvd is excluded by latitude). The Jamaica Av to Metropolitan Av segments are kept although they run about 0.35 mi north of Union Tpke (Union Tpke is not a timepoint; its position is estimated from the UNION TPKE/CRESCENT APARTMENTS stop at lat 40.7071). They are also in corridor 30: do not add the two corridors together. The plan names Q52 SBS and Q53 SBS, but their pairs are Woodhaven Blvd/Jamaica Av to Queens Blvd/59 Av or Hoffman Dr (3.1 mi, about 30% inside the limits, one stop named for another street) and Woodhaven Blvd/Jamaica Av to Cross Bay Blvd/16-17 Rd (6.7 mi), so no SBS segment is included and the speeds here are Q11/Q21 local speeds. Q21 rows and the Q11 Rockaway Blvd/Liberty Av timepoints end in 2025-08; from 2025-09 the Q11 uses stop ids 982119 and 982500 for the same stretch.
corridors.public_note: Measured on Q11 and Q21 along Woodhaven Blvd and Cross Bay Blvd from Metropolitan Av to 107 Av, about 2.4 miles per direction against the plan's 2 miles. Woodhaven/Metropolitan uses some of the same segments.

corridors.name: Jamaica Ave
corridors.definition: Segments on Jamaica Av between Sutphin Blvd and about 169th St.
corridors.notes: Plan: "Jamaica Avenue, Sutphin Boulevard to 169th Street", 1 mile, the Jamaica Av Busway, 139,000 riders. Both stops must lie between lon -73.809 (146 St, at Sutphin Blvd) and -73.789 (170 St, one block east of 169 St), a tolerance of about 0.1 mi. Stated exception to the both-stops rule: the eastbound Q54 and Q56 segments end at 170 ST/JAMAICA AV, a stop on 170 St at the corner (0.02 mi from JAMAICA AV/170 ST). Without them the corridor would have no eastbound data. Excluded: Q110 Jamaica Av/168 St to 188 St (1.2 mi, almost all east of the limit), Q54/Q56 138 St to 147 Pl and Q24/Q54/Q56 Sutphin Blvd or 146 St to Queens Blvd (west of the limit), and pairs with one stop on another street (Q30/Q31 Jamaica Av/165 St to Archer Av, Q110 88 Av/Parsons Blvd to Jamaica Av/168 St). Westbound stop ids changed in mid-2025, so each route has a before and an after version of the same segment.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q54 and Q56 along Jamaica Av from Sutphin Blvd to about 170 St, close to the plan's Sutphin Blvd to 169th St, within about 0.1 miles.

corridors.name: Merrick Blvd
corridors.definition: Segments with both stops on Merrick Blvd from Liberty Av (approx 104 Av/Liberty) to Linden Blvd.
corridors.notes: Plan: "Merrick Boulevard, Liberty Avenue to Linden Boulevard", 1 mile, 77,000 riders. The north end is MERRICK BLVD/104 AV eastbound and MERRICK BLVD/LIBERTY AV westbound, within about 0.1 mi of each other. Only Q5 has rows after June 2025 (eastbound stop id 505313 replaces 500451); the Q84 and Q85 segments listed have rows only through 2025-06. After the June 2025 timepoint change Q84, Q85, Q86, Q87 and Q89 report this stretch as Merrick Blvd/Linden Blvd to Archer Av/165 St or Jamaica Center to Merrick Blvd/Linden Blvd (1.3 to 1.7 mi, one stop off Merrick Blvd) and are left out, so the corridor speed from mid-2025 is Q5 only. Limited-pattern pairs ending at LIBERTY AV/MERRICK BLVD (around the corner) and Q4 pairs ending on Linden Blvd are also left out; Merrick Blvd south of Linden Blvd is outside the limits.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q5, Q84 and Q85 on Merrick Blvd from Liberty Av to Linden Blvd. Some stop ids changed in mid 2025 and some segments lack data in some months, so fewer segments carry the figures than are listed.

corridors.name: Sutphin/Guy R Brewer Blvd
corridors.definition: Guy R Brewer Blvd between Archer Av and Linden Blvd (the shortest segments that contain the plan's Liberty Av to Archer Av block), plus Sutphin Blvd over the full length the catalog covers (Rockaway Blvd to 88 Av).
corridors.notes: Plan: "Guy R Brewer Boulevard, Liberty Avenue to Archer Avenue", Q111, Q112, Q113, Q114, Q115, 13,000 riders. 1 WebSearch by the reviewer found a DOT presentation for the same one-block stretch and nothing that sets limits for Sutphin Blvd. Three review changes. (1) The four first-pass Brewer segments (both stops on Brewer, Q111 and Q114) have rows only for 2025-01 to 2025-06, so they give no baseline and no post-plan data. Since the June 2025 timepoint change the same stretch is reported as GUY R BREWER BLVD/SAYRES AV or /LINDEN BLVD to or from ARCHER AV/160 ST or ARCHER AV/PARSONS BL. Those pairs were added as a stated exception to the both-stops rule: the Archer Av stop is the terminal approach, 0.15 to 0.19 mi from Brewer (about 12 to 15% of the segment). They are marked with an "exception" field and can be dropped by anyone who wants the strict rule, at the cost of having no Brewer data after June 2025. (2) The first pass said the segments overshoot Liberty Av by about 0.4 mi. By the catalog coordinates Liberty Av crosses Brewer about 0.2 mi south of Archer Av, so about 0.9 to 1.0 mi of each segment (three quarters or more) is south of the plan limits; this is a coarse stand-in for the project block. (3) Sutphin Blvd is in the corridor name but was left out because the plan gives it no limits. The other no-limit streets in this tracker are mapped at the full length the catalog covers, so the Sutphin pairs were added: Q6 N Rockaway Blvd to Archer Av, Q40 S 88 Av to Jamaica Av, and Q6 S SUTPHIN BLVD/91 AV to ROCKAWAY BLVD/150 ST (exception: the last stop is 0.08 mi around the corner on Rockaway Blvd). This is an assumption about extent; drop the SUTPHIN BLVD segments to track Brewer alone. Not included: Brewer south of Linden Blvd (outside the plan limits), Q112 (no pair on Brewer), Q51 pairs on Linden Blvd, and the many Sutphin Blvd pairs with one stop on another street (Q8, Q9, Q40, Q41, Q60 at Sutphin Blvd/Archer Av).
corridors.public_note: Measured on the Q111, Q113, Q114, Q115, Q40 and Q6 on Guy R Brewer Blvd (Archer Av to Linden Blvd) and Sutphin Blvd. The plan's stretch, Liberty Av to Archer Av, is only about 0.2 miles, so these segments are much longer than the project. The plan gives no limits for Sutphin Blvd, so we used its full length in the data.

corridors.name: Bedford Ave
corridors.definition: Segments whose two timepoint stops are both on Bedford Av in Brooklyn.
corridors.notes: Plan text gives no limits for Bedford Ave. Only B49 southbound has both-on-Bedford pairs (Bergen St to Avenue D, 2.5 mi); coverage is one-directional (northbound B49 timepoints are on Rogers Av, reaching Bedford only at Dean St). The Church Av to Avenue D segment is a low-volume variant (about 2,800 trips in 21 months). The main B49 pattern, Bedford Av/Church Av to FOSTER AV/BEDFORD AV (0.85 mi along Bedford, about 41,000 trips), is excluded because its end stop is named on Foster Av. Bedford Av north of Fulton St (northbound B44 and B44+ SBS) is not represented: those segments run Fulton St/Nostrand Av or Nostrand Av/Avenue H to Bedford Av/Flushing Av to Williamsburg Bridge Plaza, one stop on Bedford only. B62 touches Bedford Av/Broadway only.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B49 on Bedford Av, Bergen St to Avenue D. Coverage is mostly one direction, because northbound timepoints sit on Rogers Av.

corridors.name: Marcy Ave
corridors.definition: Marcy Ave, Borinquen Pl to Broadway, Brooklyn (plan p.23).
corridors.notes: Plan limits are Borinquen Pl to Broadway, but no catalog stop is ON Marcy Av (it only appears as a cross street), so no segment has both timepoints on it. Plan says a new bus lane will serve 3 routes. UNMAPPED: needs a stop-level or GIS source.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan limits are Borinquen Pl to Broadway, but no bus stop in the data is on Marcy Av itself, so no segment can be matched.

corridors.name: Livingston St
corridors.definition: Livingston St segments between Court St and Smith St (inside plan limits Gallatin Pl to Court St).
corridors.notes: Plan limits Gallatin Pl to Court St. Only B45 has both-on-Livingston timepoints (Court St and Smith St). Smith St to Gallatin Pl is not a timepoint-to-timepoint segment, so most of the stated extent is uncovered; B45 and B67 segments that continue east from Smith St end on Atlantic Av or Flatbush Av. Longitude clip -73.992 to -73.984. The westbound segment is 0.52 mi against 0.20 mi eastbound for the same two corners (stops about 0.2 mi apart), so the westbound path is not the direct line (probably a terminal loop).
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B45 on Livingston St between Court St and Smith St. The plan covers Gallatin Pl to Court St, so most of the stated stretch is not covered. Only the eastbound segment is used, because the source changed the recorded length of the westbound segment during 2026, which would look like a speed change. One segment is a small sample.

corridors.name: DeKalb/Lafayette Ave
corridors.definition: DeKalb Av / Lafayette Av segments from Flatbush Av east to about Broadway (Bed-Stuy), plan limits Broadway to Flatbush Av.
corridors.notes: Plan: DeKalb and Lafayette Avenues, Broadway to Flatbush Avenue (labelled Brooklyn/Queens, though both limits are in Brooklyn; if the east end was meant to reach Ridgewood, the B38 DeKalb Av segments Malcolm X Blvd to Wyckoff Av to Seneca Av would also belong and are not included). B38 Local and Limited. No catalog stop sits on Broadway at DeKalb or Lafayette, so the Broadway crossing is approximated at lon -73.927 from the Broadway alignment; one WebSearch returned no coordinates. Lafayette Av/Patchen Av (-73.9281) and DeKalb Av/Malcolm X Blvd (-73.9316) are the last stops west of Broadway; segments continuing to DeKalb Av/Wyckoff Av cross Broadway and are excluded. West end not covered: B38 E Fulton St/Bond St to Lafayette Av/Nostrand Av (1.75 mi, mostly on Lafayette Av) and B38 W DeKalb Av/Vanderbilt Av to Fulton St/Duffield St (0.84 mi) have one stop on Fulton St, so Flatbush Av to Nostrand Av (eastbound) and Flatbush Av to Vanderbilt Av (westbound) are missing.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B38 along DeKalb Av and Lafayette Av from Flatbush Av east to about Broadway, close to the plan's Broadway to Flatbush Av limits.

corridors.name: Flatbush Ave
corridors.definition: All segments whose two timepoint stops are both on Flatbush Av in Brooklyn (full-length rapid bus corridor), not only the 2026 project limits Livingston St to Grand Army Plaza.
corridors.notes: Extent assumption (why "partial"): the plan states limits for project 39, "Flatbush Avenue, Livingston Street to Grand Army Plaza" (2026 center-running lanes), and separately promises rapid bus on "the full length of the Flatbush Avenue corridor" by 2030 (rapid_bus_corridor=true). The full length is used. Only two mapped segments touch the 2026 project limits: B41 N Empire Blvd to Atlantic Av and B41 S Atlantic Av to Ocean Av, each about half inside (Grand Army Plaza to Atlantic Av); Atlantic Av to Livingston St has no both-on-Flatbush segment (B41 runs Flatbush/Atlantic to Cadman Plaza West). B41 Local and Limited, plus B9 E Avenue P to Kings Plaza. Northbound B41 lists two stop variants for the same stretch (Troy Av to Nostrand Av or E 31 St, then to Church Av), so summed miles (about 8.8 N vs 6.3 S) overstate; one pass is about 6.2 mi. Removed in review: Q90 S Flatbush Av/Pacific St to Ocean Av. That row has 6 trips in a single month, catalog borough "Other" and 8xxxxx stop ids, and runs Atlantic Av to Prospect Park; it looks like a subway-replacement shuttle reusing the Q90 id, not the Q90 bus route (Flushing to LaGuardia). Excluded by the both-stops-on-street rule: B9, B2, Q35 and B103 segments with one stop on a cross street, Flatbush Av north of Atlantic Av and south of Kings Plaza.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B41 and B9 on Flatbush Av over the full length the data covers, Kings Plaza to Atlantic Av. The plan's 2026 project is only Livingston St to Grand Army Plaza, so speeds include a longer stretch than the project.

corridors.name: Utica Ave
corridors.definition: All segments whose two timepoint stops are both on Utica Av.
corridors.notes: Plan gives no limits (rapid bus study corridor). Speeds here are almost entirely B46 local: the B46+ SBS timepoint segments run Utica Av/Avenue N to MALCOLM X BLVD/DE KALB AV (5.1 mi each way, about 4 mi of it on Utica Av, about 131,000 trips in 21 months) and are excluded because one stop is on Malcolm X Blvd. The only SBS segment kept is B46+ S Avenue N to Fillmore Av (0.28 mi, ends at a non-public stop). Northbound B46 lists two stop-id variants of each segment (used in different months), so summed miles (9.0 N vs 3.7 S) overstate; one pass is 4.5 mi N (Fillmore Av to Fulton St) and 3.7 mi S (Eastern Pkwy to Fillmore Av). Southbound Fulton St to Eastern Pkwy is missing (segment starts at Malcolm X Blvd/Marion St). Utica Av south of Fillmore Av (to Kings Plaza) has no both-on-Utica pair.
corridors.public_note: Measured along Utica Av from Avenue N to Fulton St. The plan gives no limits. Most trips are B46 local; the B46 SBS segments mostly end off Utica Av and are largely left out.

corridors.name: Church Ave
corridors.definition: All segments whose two timepoint stops are both on Church Av in Brooklyn.
corridors.notes: Plan gives no limits. Only B35 Local has both-on-Church pairs, McDonald Av to Kings Hwy (about 3.1 mi each way). B35 Limited is not represented: its segments run Church Av/McDonald Av to Hegeman Av/Watkins St (4.3 mi) with one stop off Church Av. Church Av west of McDonald Av and east of Kings Hwy have none. Overlaps corridor 42 (same segments) by design.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B35 local along Church Av from McDonald Av to Kings Hwy, about 3.1 miles each way. The plan gives no limits. Church Av outside that stretch has no usable segment. Kensington-JFK uses these segments too.

corridors.name: Kensington-JFK
corridors.definition: Church Av, Linden Blvd, New Lots Av and Conduit Av, per plan (visioning for rapid bus connecting Kensington to JFK).
corridors.notes: Plan names the four streets but no extents. Catalog has Church Av (B35) and New Lots Av (B15) pairs only; zero pairs with both stops on Linden Blvd and none on Conduit Av; the only Linden stop is LINDEN BLVD/ELDERT LN (Cypress Hills), reached by 2 B15 segments that start on New Lots Av (kept because both stops are on named corridor streets). Linden east of lon -73.825 (Q4/Q51 in Queens) excluded as beyond Conduit/JFK access. Church segments duplicate corridor 41. The New Lots Av to Linden Blvd/Eldert Ln segments are 1.22 to 1.28 mi against 1.05 mi straight-line, so a short connector on streets not named by the plan is included in them. B15 stop ids changed during the data period, so Ashford St and Cleveland St / Warwick St variants cover different months, not extra service. Not included (stops named on cross streets): B20 Ashford St/Linden Blvd to Eldert Ln/Linden Blvd, which runs along Linden Blvd.
corridors.public_note: The plan names four streets and gives no limits. We measured B15 and B35 segments on New Lots Av and Church Av. No segment has both stops on Linden Blvd or Conduit Av, so those streets are not covered. Church Ave uses some of the same segments.

corridors.name: Linden Blvd
corridors.definition: Linden Blvd, Fountain Av to Conduit Av, Brooklyn/Queens (plan p.24).
corridors.notes: Plan defines the corridor (Linden Blvd, Fountain Av to Conduit Av) but no catalog segment has both timepoints named on Linden Blvd there, so it stays UNMAPPED under the both-stops-on-street rule. Near misses, for anyone relaxing the rule: (1) B20 N/S ELDERT LN/LINDEN BLVD to ASHFORD ST/LINDEN BLVD (1.1 mi, about 38,000 trips each way, all 21 months) runs along Linden Blvd, but both stops are named on the cross streets and roughly half the segment lies west of Fountain Av (Fountain Av has no timepoint; position estimated from the street grid); (2) B15 LINDEN BLVD/ELDERT LN to DREW ST/LINDEN BLVD (0.13 mi E, 0.34 mi W), one block; (3) B15 New Lots Av to Linden Blvd/Eldert Ln pairs, mixed-street, reported under corridor 42. B15 Linden Blvd/Eldert Ln to Lefferts Blvd/AirTrain (2.4 mi) leaves Linden Blvd. Q4/Q51 Linden Blvd segments are in Queens far east of Conduit Av.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan limits are Linden Blvd from Fountain Av to Conduit Av, but no bus segment has both stops on that stretch.

corridors.name: South Brooklyn Crosstown
corridors.definition: B82 SBS route and the B82 local segments between the SBS terminals, Cropsey Av (Bay 37 St / 24 Av) to Seaview Av/Pennsylvania Av (plan p.24/p.30: 7.5 miles of streets along the B82 SBS corridor).
corridors.notes: Route-based, not street-based: the plan defines this corridor only as "7.5 miles of streets ... along the B82 SBS corridor" (South Brooklyn Crosstown Select Bus Service). One WebSearch (nyc.gov BRT pages) did not give project limits, so which 7.5 mi of the roughly 9 mi SBS route is meant is unknown; the whole SBS route is used as an upper bound. Removed in review: the three B82 local segments between Stillwell Terminal / Mermaid Av (Coney Island) and Cropsey Av, which the SBS does not serve. B82 local between the SBS terminals sums to 8.96 mi E and 9.03 mi W, matching the SBS (8.99 E, 9.00 W), so local and SBS cover the same streets and summed miles double count. B82+ SBS timepoints are terminals only (one 9.0 mi hop E; 1.95 + 7.05 mi W). B82 E Cropsey Av to Kings Hwy/W 7 St appears as two stop variants in different months. Timepoints are on Cropsey Av, Kings Hwy, Avenue P, Flatlands Av, Glenwood Rd, E 98 St and Seaview Av.
corridors.public_note: The plan defines this corridor as 7.5 miles of streets along the B82 SBS route without saying which streets. We measured the whole B82 SBS route and the B82 local between the same ends, so the figures cover the route, not only the project.

corridors.name: Avenue J
corridors.definition: Avenue J, Brooklyn.
corridors.notes: Plan gives no extents. Only one catalog timepoint is on Avenue J (AVENUE J/CONEY ISLAND AV, B6 and B11), so no segment has both timepoints on Avenue J. UNMAPPED under the both-stops-on-street rule. Buses that use Avenue J appear only in mixed-street segments: B6 Bay Pkwy/60 St to Avenue J/Coney Island Av to Glenwood Rd/Nostrand Av, and B11 50 St/18 Av to Avenue J/Coney Island Av to Nostrand Av/Flatbush Av.
corridors.public_note: Not mapped. The plan gives no limits and only one bus timepoint is on Avenue J, so no segment can be matched.

corridors.name: Bay Parkway
corridors.definition: Bay Pkwy and Cropsey Av segments with both timepoints on those streets.
corridors.notes: Plan: Bay Parkway and Cropsey Avenue, 6 routes. Only B6 gives both-on-Bay-Pkwy pairs; there are no both-on-Cropsey Av pairs, so Cropsey is not covered. Mixed pairs with a Cropsey Av stop at one end and a Bay Pkwy stop at the other (B6 Cropsey/Bay 37 St or Harway Av to Bay Pkwy/86 St) are included because both stops are on named corridor streets. B6 Local and Limited. The westbound Bay Pkwy/86 St to Cropsey Av/25 Av segments are 1.39 mi against 0.68 mi straight-line, so the path includes a loop beyond the direct Bay Pkwy to Cropsey Av line; the two rows are stop-id variants from different months. B82 and B82+ stop on Cropsey Av (Bay 37 St, 24 Av) but their adjoining timepoints are on other streets, so they are excluded; B70 Cropsey Av stops (Bay Ridge end) likewise.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B6 on Bay Pkwy from 60 St to 86 St. The plan also names Cropsey Av, which has no usable stop pair, so it is not covered.

corridors.name: 86th St
corridors.definition: 86 St in Brooklyn (Bay Ridge/Bensonhurst), both timepoint stops on 86 ST.
corridors.notes: Plan gives no extents. Covered: B1 both directions Stillwell Av to 18 Av (1.2 mi) and B16 southbound 5 Av to Narrows Av (0.8 mi). Not covered: 18 Av to 5 Av, about 1.6 mi (B1 runs 86 St/18 Av to 87 St/4 Av, 1.7 mi, end stop on 87 St), and B16 northbound (NARROWS AV/86 ST to 86 St/5 Av, 0.76 mi along 86 St, start stop named on Narrows Av). B64, B3 and B4 touch 86 St at one stop only. Manhattan E/W 86 St (M86+) excluded by lat/lon.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the B1 and B16 on 86 St in Brooklyn: B1 from Stillwell Av to 18 Av and B16 southbound from 5 Av to Narrows Av. About 1.6 miles between 18 Av and 5 Av is not covered.

corridors.name: Bay St
corridors.definition: All Staten Island segments with both timepoint stops on Bay St.
corridors.notes: Plan gives no extents. S51 both directions Victory Blvd to Hylan Blvd (1.8 mi) and S81 Limited southbound Victory Blvd to St Johns Av; no S81 northbound Bay St pair in the catalog. Bay St north of Victory Blvd is not covered: S51, S74, S76, S78, S81, S84 and S86 segments there run Bay St/Victory Blvd to St George Ferry ramps (one stop on Bay St). Bay St south of Hylan Blvd / St Johns Av likewise (next stop on Lily Pond Av).
corridors.public_note: Measured on the S51 and S81 on Bay St in Staten Island: S51 from Victory Blvd to Hylan Blvd, and S81 southbound to St Johns Av. Bay St north of Victory Blvd is not covered.

corridors.name: Victory Blvd
corridors.definition: Victory Blvd segments from Bay St west to Clove Rd, inside the plan limits Bay St to Little Clove Rd.
corridors.notes: Plan limit is Bay St to Little Clove Rd. Little Clove Rd is not a catalog timepoint. It lies west of Clove Rd: MTA stop 200583 Victory Blvd/Little Clove Rd is served by westbound S61, S62 and S66, and westbound stop ids rise from Forest Av (200573) to Clove Rd (200580), which puts it about three stops past Clove Rd (one WebSearch by the mapper, one WebSearch plus the MTA Bus Time stop page in review; no coordinates found, so the distance is not measured). So all mapped segments are inside the limits and the last stretch, Clove Rd to Little Clove Rd, is not covered: the next segments run Clove Rd to Jewett Av / Perry Av (1.4 mi), mostly beyond the limit, and are excluded. S61, S62, S91 and S92 share the same two physical segments each way and S66 the Forest Av to Bay St one, so summed miles count the street several times. Plan cites 16 routes; S93 has Victory Blvd pairs only west of Clove Rd, and S46, S78, S96 touch Victory Blvd/Bay St at one stop.
corridors.public_note: Measured on Victory Blvd from Bay St to Clove Rd on the S61, S62, S66, S91 and S92. The plan runs to Little Clove Rd, a few stops further west, which is not covered.

corridors.name: Richmond Ave
corridors.definition: All segments whose two timepoint stops are both on Richmond Av (Staten Island); Port Richmond Av excluded.
corridors.notes: Plan gives no extents. Covered: Hylan Blvd to Yukon Av (S79+ SBS, one 3.3 mi hop, toward the Staten Island Mall only) and Victory Blvd to Vedder Av / Monsey Pl (S44 Local, S94 and S89 Limited, 1.3 to 1.4 mi). The two S79+ rows (direction S and W) are the same segment relabelled between months, not two services. S79+ in the other direction is split at Eltingville Transit Center, which is not named on Richmond Av, so it is excluded. Gap between Yukon Av and Victory Blvd (segments there start at Staten Island Mall / Marsh Av). Port Richmond Av is a different street and is excluded.
corridors.public_note: Measured on the S44, S79 SBS, S89 and S94 along Richmond Av from Hylan Blvd to Vedder Av. The plan gives no limits.
